newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index little changed, volume up.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index little changed, volume up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed down 0.08 percent in higher trade boosted by exchanges on leasing firm Tunisie Leasing LEAS.TN, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 494.90 points, down from 495.30 on Wednesday.
Total volume was 2.18 million dinars against 1.68 million dinars over the previous session.
Turnover on the first market was 1.75 million dinars with 55,206 shares changing hands. Most of the trade was on leasing firm Tunisie Leasing LEAS.TN with the exchange of 40,600 shares.
Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie fell 0.9 dinar to 34.9 dinars. Amen Bank edged lower 0.88 dinar to 35.5. Societe Tunisienne de Banque slid 0.53 dinar to 16.99 dinars.
Banque de Tunisie gained 0.98 dinar to 79 dinars.

Chemical firm Al-Kimia rose 0.5 dinar to 46. Compagnie Internationale de Leasing CIL was up 0.48 dinar to 17.9 dinars. Airline Tunis Air advanced 0.34 dinars with 5,965 shares changing hands. ($1=1.08 dinar)
